name: admin-customers-01
title: Customers admin dashboard
description: A controlled customers list with derived counts, live search and create/edit callbacks. Includes loading, empty, no-results, failure/retry and permission states; the application owns data and persistence.

idle.how: Use success for a loaded list; it does not fetch on mount.

loading.how: status="loading"; hide stale rows and announce progress.

empty.how: status="success" with customers=[]; show the first-customer action when onAdd and canWrite are supplied.

no-results.how: A nonmatching query on a nonempty customer collection; Clear search restores the unfiltered list.

error.how: status="error" and optional error; onRetry requests recovery without clearing query.

success.how: status="success" (default) and customers; optional successMessage announces an application-confirmed save.

submitting.how: Compose customer-edit-01 and supply its submitting status while the application saves.

validation-error.how: Compose customer-edit-01 for field validation and server validation errors.

permission-denied.how: status="permission-denied" hides customer records. canWrite=false preserves read access and disables add/edit actions.

unsaved.how: The edit form guards Cancel unless onCancelRequest delegates it to the host; guard dialog dismissal/navigation too.

offline.how: The application detects connectivity and selects error/retry or its own offline explanation.

partial.how: The application owns pagination and partial-result disclosure; customers is the supplied collection.

actions.name: search
consumer: Supply both props for a controlled query; otherwise local search is built in.

actions.name: create
consumer: Open and authorize a creation flow. No callback means the action is disabled.

actions.name: edit
consumer: Open the selected customer editor and persist successful changes to customers.

actions.name: retry
consumer: Retry the data request and provide the resulting status; no request is made by the block.

responsive.strategy: At narrow widths, retain customer identity, segment and edit action; secondary columns appear from sm/md. The application chooses which data to expose.

consumer: Supply customers and asynchronous request status; the default records are examples, not a backend.
Authorize operations on the server and set canWrite/status from that outcome; disabled buttons are not an authorization boundary.
Connect onAdd, onEdit and onRetry; update customers only after an application-confirmed save.
Preserve local columns, content overrides and tokens when adapting or updating the copied source.
